t: This is a bust of Admiral of the Fleet David Beatty, the first Earl Beatty, made by the Scottish sculptor William McMillan, who is known for a number of public statues across the United Kingdom. Beatty was a Royal Navy officer who served in the Mahdist War and in the response to the Boxer Rebellion. In 1916 he commanded the Battle Cruiser Fleet at Jutland, a tactically indecisive battle. His aggressive approach was often contrasted with the caution of his commander, Admiral Jellicoe. He is remembered for saying, as two of his ships exploded, that there seemed to be something wrong with our bloody ships that day.
